videos.title: Limited Edition
videos.description:
Want to sell more physical products without more ads?

Try the “in the box” collab most brands never think to do.

A limited edition run can put your product in front of the exact right people.

And everyone wins - the partner, the customer, and you.

videos.description:
There’s a way to make the exact product you mention on a YouTube Live show up as a clickable pop-up right on the video.

It’s one of those “why isn’t everyone doing this?” moments.

If you sell physical products on Shopify, this is worth looking into.

videos.title: There's a right and wrong way to do this.
videos.description:
“Upsell” is a swear word - until it actually makes the customer happier.

There’s a simple difference between squeezing more money out of someone and offering an add-on they’d gladly choose anyway.

If you sell physical products, bundles can be the easiest way to increase revenue while making the purchase feel like a win.

#shopify #ecommerce #entrepreneur

videos.title: The 3 Levels of Physical Products to Sell
